title: polygala oxyphylla var. laureola
intro: Polygala oxyphylla var. laureola, commonly known as Yuan Zhi or Sweet-scented milkwort, is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant belonging to the Polygalaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to calm the mind, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Polygala oxyphylla var. laureola include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
